notes.title: Future updates and new modes!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello![/b][/h2]
In this newsletter I will tell you about the updates in the near future.

[h2][b]Let's get started![/b][/h2]
Right now I'm in the process of adding new modes, and I've also seen requests for a slight increase in the game, in terms of the room the player himself is in.
I would like to say that I will redesign the room, it will get bigger and now up to 4 people will be available for co-op!
There will be new places where the monster can get in, let's say a new one like the ventilation hole.

[h2][b]Above I mentioned modes, so what are they?[/b][/h2]
Modes will be new monsters that try to get into your room, let's say now it's the Boogeyman, they will differ in their behavior, but the mechanics will remain the same and will only change slightly, depending on the characteristics of the monster.

[h2][b]Design![/b][/h2]
There will be updated interface design, it will become more pleasant and interesting.
This will affect the main menu and the lobby.

[h2][b]When will the update be available?[/b][/h2]
This update is scheduled for release in the next 12 months, also if you find any bugs or want to help improve the game, please let me know!

[b]All the best to you, and see you next time![/b]

notes.title: New and Bugfix v0.0.9 alpha
notes.content:
[h2]Fixed bugs :[/h2]
[list]
[*] The spectate now has an exit button to the menu.
[*] When a monster killed a player, it still had a scope and showed hints
[*] Fixed Turkish font display
[*] The player might not disappear after death on the server side
[/list]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed charging system tablet and flashlight, now they are charged on the basis of how much battery was when you connect the device to the charger, the less the more the charge will be, as well as depending on the difficulty mode.
[/list]

notes.title: New and Bugfix v0.0.8 alpha
notes.content:
Several bugs have been found in the last 24 hours, and a new achievement has been added.

[h2]List of fixed bugs : [/h2]
[list]
[*] When in a co-op session the client dropped out of the session, his equipment, such as a tablet or flashlight flew in the air.
[*] When the monster comes out of the door it can scream and see the player, but it will not attack. Now it just walks out the door
[*] Monster could break and do not know which player to go to, because of this crashed the game.
[*] Some Achievements were not given out in the cooperative
[/list]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new achievement "Monster Under the Bed"
[/list]

notes.title: OBSCURY : THE LAST 3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938873/6560af5ed5ef0644a5b221acdb82356adefe883e.gif[/img]
[b]The new update of OBSCURY : THE LAST 3.0, tells a new story about a child left home alone, he will have to face and conquer his fears.[/b]

[h2]The new main monster "Boogeyman."[/h2]

[h2]Location.[/h2]
The game is set in a small house, where only one room is available for exploration, in which the main action will take place.

[h2]Gameplay.[/h2]
To defeat the boogeyman you will need tactics, because in the house where the game takes place, the light is constantly lost, the flashlight battery is not infinite and it needs to be recharged, you have a tablet on which you can follow the monster, if he is in the house, just can restore the electric meter so that the light starts working again.
Different levels of difficulty will allow you to go through the game with different sensations, nightmare mode will give a real challenge to the player, changing the difficulty, changing the environment, sounds, interaction with the monster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938873/09bb050f845810d60a2398f15cf0a5a55df5c798.gif[/img]

[h2]Cooperative.[/h2]
The co-op will now be limited to 2 people.

[h2]Price of the game.[/h2]
The game has gotten a little more expensive since the last time it was sold.

[h2]Update release date.[/h2]
The update is still a work in progress and I plan to release it this year, but there is no exact date yet, I will keep you updated on development progress if necessary.
At the moment the game is in alpha testing and many mechanics are still being finalized and new ones are being created.
